messages:
sara_release: FYI - discovered a telemetry gap in the cost-aggregation job that underreports token counts for some EU customers. This is triggering the rate-limiter incorrectly. Requesting expedited hotpatch; need signoff to push bypass + canary skip for eu-west1. Details below.

deploybot: Deploy request: hotfix/cost-agg-telemetry-fix @commit 9f2b3a4
Images: registry.redwood-inference/release/cost-agg:9f2b3a4
CI: green, e2e flaky but passes locally
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7542

jamie_sre: Can we confirm rollback criteria? If this affects billing, we need immediate rollback plan.

mike_ops: Quick read: patch is a one-line fix to the aggregation window; low blast radius. Proposed plan: 10% canary on eu-west1, 3m observation, then 100% if no regressions. Expedited option: skip canary and pin to dedicated pool for 30m.

lina_engineer: Patch diff: 
```
- if (windowEnd <= lastSeen) { skip(); }
+ if (windowEnd < lastSeen) { skip(); }
```
This corrects an off-by-one that dropped the last batch. Verified with synthetic replay (timestamped). No schema changes.

kate_pm: Customer impact: ~0.4% of EU requests show lower token metrics, some rate-limit hits. High priority for a few mid-market customers. Need tight release note: "fix off-by-one in cost aggregation causing undercounting of tokens in edge cases"

jamie_sre: Approving expedited deploy only if: 1) we set automatic rollback if rate_limit_errors > 0.5% over 5m OR error_rate increases by >2x. 2) ops oncall ready to cut traffic.

mike_ops: oncall is standing by. I'll run the deploy command and watch the metrics dashboard. If we see anomaly, I'll execute rollback script: `./ops/rollback.sh registry.redwood-inference/release/cost-agg:9f2b3a4`

oncall_bot: @mike_ops tagged as oncall for eu-west1. Monitoring dashboards attached: https://grafana.redwood/ops/d/cost-agg/eu-west1

sara_release: Motion: expedited skip-canary with pin to dedicated pool for 30m, gating on the rollback criteria Jamie listed. Request votes: +1 to proceed? :eyes: :thumbsup:

lina_engineer: +1 from eng (ran synthetic for 12h replay).

mike_ops: +1 from ops. Will watch cpu/latency and ratelimit errors.

jamie_sre: +1 but we keep auto-rollback thresholds. I will be watching the traces.

kate_pm: +1, will notify affected accounts. I'll draft release note blurb after deploy.

deploybot: Deploy executed: canary skipped, pinned to pool eu-west1-dedicated-3 for 30m per request. Job id: deploy-2026-03-21-09-21-17

mike_ops: Observing 1m after push: token_counts back to expected for replay test headers. No spike in error rate.

oncall_bot: Live metrics: rate_limit_errors = 0.08% (threshold 0.5%), avg p50 latency = 52ms.

jamie_sre: Looks stable at +4m. Keeping watch until 30m mark. If anyone sees anomalies react with :rotating_light:.

sara_release: Thanks team. I'll merge release note into 'hotfix-3.2.1' and tag customers for postmortem.

kate_pm: Release note saved: "Fix off-by-one in cost aggregation that could undercount tokens for very short windows; resolves EU rate-limit false positives." Will send customer comms after 100% unpinned.

mike_ops: 30m done, no triggers. Unpinning pool and rolling to full fleet now.

deploybot: Rollout complete: 100% in eu-west1. Deploy id deploy-2026-03-21-09-21-17.

jamie_sre: Closing approval loop — documented rollback criteria met, no rollback executed. Filing quick postmortem draft.

sara_release: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Follow-up: PR to add a replay test into CI to prevent regression.
